list.title: Restaurants
list.subtitle: Every menu on the platform, in one place.
list.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, address or owner email
list.emptyBody: Create your first restaurant and invite its owner. It takes less than a minute.
list.noResultsBody: Try a different search or clear the filters.

duplicate.title: Duplicate restaurant
duplicate.description: Copies the settings, categories and items of {name} into a new restaurant. Owners and the custom domain are not copied.

toggle.suspendBody: Guests will no longer see this menu. You can turn it back on at any time.
toggle.activateBody: The menu becomes visible to guests again.

remove.title: Delete {name}?
remove.body: This permanently deletes the restaurant with its categories, items, photos and owner access. It cannot be undone.

form.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes. It appears in the menu link and QR code.
form.slugInvalid: Use 3–40 characters: a–z, 0–9 and dashes (not at the start or end).
form.slugReserved: This word is reserved by the platform.

new.title: New restaurant
new.subtitle: Set up a menu in under a minute. The owner can add photos, items and details later.
new.ownerEmailHintLocal: We'll create the owner's account with a temporary password and link it to this restaurant.
new.ownerEmailHintSupabase: We'll email an invite so the owner can choose a password.

aurora.name: Aurora
aurora.description: Light and airy with soft cards. Great for cafés and bakeries.

noir.name: Noir
noir.description: Dark and elegant. Perfect for fine dining and evening venues.

pop.name: Pop
pop.description: Bold and playful. Made for burgers, juice bars and street food.

new.successBody: The menu is live with an empty template. Add categories and items next.
new.tempPasswordBody: Shown only once. Share it privately; the owner can change it after signing in.
new.linkedExisting: {email} already had an account and is now linked as owner.
new.inviteFailed: The restaurant was created, but adding the owner failed: {reason}

detail.settingsBody: Only the agency can change these.
detail.activeHint: When off, guests can't open this menu.
detail.customDomainHint: Point the domain's DNS to the platform first, then enter it here. Leave empty to remove it.
detail.slugWarning: Changing the address breaks printed QR codes that use the old link.
detail.membersBody: People who can edit this menu.
detail.noMembers: No one can edit this menu yet. Add the owner below.
detail.removeMemberBody: They will no longer be able to edit this menu. Their account itself is kept.
detail.dangerBody: Deleting a restaurant removes its whole menu and photos for good.

errors.slug_taken: That menu address is already taken.
errors.slug_invalid: Use 3–40 characters: a–z, 0–9 and dashes (not at the start or end).
errors.slug_reserved: This word is reserved by the platform.
errors.domain_taken: Another restaurant already uses this domain.
errors.domain_invalid: Enter a valid domain such as menu.client.com (without http://).
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.read_only: Demo mode — connect Supabase to save changes.
errors.storage_failed: Couldn't copy the photos. Please try again.
errors.confirm_mismatch: The text you typed doesn't match the menu address.
errors.invite_failed: Couldn't send the invite. Check the email address and try again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
